job.title: Tesseract Guru Needed to Pull data from POS Receipts

args.cover_letter:
Recall 96% at 38 FPS; scrap reaching customers fell by half: that was the outcome of my real-time defect detection on an assembly line project, which is close to what you describe.

For Python: in the payment fraud detection with graph neural networks project I modelled accounts, devices and cards as a graph in Neo4j and trained a GraphSAGE classifier.

I have not used Tesseract OCR in client work, so I would start with a short spike and confirm the approach with you before building on it.

Plan: a short discovery call, a first working milestone you can test, then documentation and a handover call.

Is the OpenCV part already started, or would this be built from scratch?
answers: I would rather discuss this on a short call.
